title: Method
intro: We document what AI helps people do, create, discover, and sustain.

principles.title: Gains
principles.body: Describe what changed, using measures suited to the outcome. Separate observed gains, new opportunities, and expectations.

principles.title: Beneficiaries
principles.body: Identify who benefited and who could access the benefit. Note differences between groups and gaps in the evidence.

principles.title: Evidence
principles.body: Link claims to sources and comparisons. Describe what AI and people contributed, and what the evidence cannot establish.

principles.title: Over time
principles.body: Track how long gains last and what further work they enable. Keep observed persistence separate from expectations.

principles.title: Replication
principles.body: Document repeated results and the conditions involved. Where transfer is untested, state the questions to investigate.

inclusion: Each record needs a reported gain, an identifiable AI role, and a public source. Keep research findings distinct from institutional accounts. Include costs, tradeoffs, and evidence gaps. Marketing claims alone do not qualify.

foundations.title: From Incident to Intervention
foundations.note: Research on useful workflows, context, source tracing, and reuse. Applied here to benefit evidence.

foundations.title: Impact Frontiers
foundations.note: Amount of change, people reached, and duration.

foundations.title: Trustible Benefits Framework
foundations.note: Benefits for people, organizations, and society.

foundations.title: EICAT+
foundations.note: Positive ecological effects and their persistence.

foundations.title: ESMO Magnitude of Clinical Benefit Scale
foundations.note: Clinical benefit assessed with outcome-specific criteria.

foundations.title: IQWiG General Methods
foundations.note: Size of added benefit and certainty of evidence.

reuse: Download the current search results or an individual brief. Cite the saved version and original sources, retaining the comparator and limitations.
submission: Send a public source, the reported gain, and who benefited. Corrections and follow-up are welcome.
